disclosures.storage: LlamaIndex VectorMemory with its default in-memory SimpleVectorStore; fresh process and memory per benchmark case
disclosures.writePolicy: Put one user ChatMessage per accepted event with its fixture event ID in additional_kwargs; include tentative events only for an explicit tentative view
disclosures.retrievalPolicy: VectorMemory.get with question text and fixture topK or 5; map returned message event IDs in framework order
disclosures.providerCostBoundary: Local CPU embeddings only; no LLM, API key, or remote inference provider
notes: Retrieval-only adapter: it intentionally returns unsupported for typed answers and emits no proof citations.
First execution downloads the pinned 67 MB embedding model; benchmark wall time excludes model initialization and dependency startup.
